specifications.en:
🏗️ *Gurudev Specifications:*

*STRUCTURE:*
• RCC Framed Structure (Seismic Zone 3)
• 200mm external walls, 100mm internal
• Floor height: 3000mm
• Anti-termite treatment

*WALL FINISH:*
• Internal: 2 coats putty + primer + 2 coats emulsion
• Exterior: primer + 2 coats emulsion
• Bathroom: Glazed ceramic tiles (300x600mm)
• Kitchen: Ceramic tiles up to 600mm above counter

*FLOORING:*
• Vitrified tiles (600x600mm) - Living, Bedrooms, Kitchen
• Anti-skid ceramic tiles (300x300mm) - Bathroom & Balcony

*KITCHEN:*
• Granite platform (600mm wide, 800mm height)
• Quartz single bowl sink with drain board
• Chimney & water purifier points

*BATHROOMS:*
• Parryware or equivalent fittings
• Floor mounted WC with cistern
• Health faucet + Single lever diverter
• Grid false ceiling

*DOORS:*
• Main Door: Teak wood (3'6" x 7'0") with laminated finish
• Bedroom: Engineered frame (3'0" x 7'0") laminated
• Bathroom: WPC shutter (2'6" x 7'0")

*WINDOWS:*
• Powder coated aluminum / UPVC
• Sliding shutters with plain glass
• MS grills (inner side)
• French doors: Toughened glass without grills
• Ventilators: Fixed/adjustable louvered

*ELECTRICAL:*
• 3 Phase power supply
• MCB & ELCB
• Modular switches (Anchor/Schneider/ABB)
• FRLS copper wires (KEI/Polycab)
• AC points in Living & Bedrooms
• TV & Telephone points (Living room)
• Mobile charging dock (Living room)

*COMMON FEATURES:*
• 6-passenger automatic lift
• Name board in stilt
• Lift fascia with tiles & granite jamb
• Designer tile flooring in lift lobby
• Stilt lobby: Granite flooring
• Staircase: Granite (stilt), Kota/Shahbadth (floors)
• Stilt: Paver block with car park numbers
• Terrace: Cooling weathering tiles

*OUTDOOR FEATURES:*
• UG sump with WTP
• Rainwater harvesting
• Centralized STP
• CCTV surveillance (stilt pivotal locations)
• Interlocking paver block driveway
• Security booth at entrance
• Compound wall (1500mm)
• Landscape at appropriate places
• Convex mirror for safe turning

👉 Innum enna details venum? (price / location / amenities)
